Dear Mr. Secretary:
The environmental statement dated Mav 26, 1972, intended to implement Executive Order 11644, has been reviewed with considerable interest. We have already relayed to the Fresident our concerns about the Executive Order. Our comments in this letter will arrive later than your July 11 deadline but we hope not too late for your consideration.
An environmental statement is a document intended to call attention to all real and potential benefits and damages that can occur from a certain action. For this reason it tends to be a belt and suspenders type of document. To protect the authors, they tend to include all possible contingencies.
Environmental statements are written by staff people. In the government service, particularly, the people who write such statements are usually unschooled in economics. The real adverse economic effects of the actions proposed are not fully evaluated.
